_note: Transposed from OpenAIAdapter.parseStreamEvent. Chat Completions chunks are not a discriminated union: every chunk has the same shape and the meaning is in which fields of choices[0].delta are populated. So this is one ordered list of self-guarding rules, which is what the hand-written parser is. The two `stop` rules are its two early returns.

toolIdByIndex._note: Only the first fragment of a tool call carries an id; the argument fragments are correlated by index.

audio._note: Whether the audio media block has been opened, so media_start fires once.

on._note: Moderation arrives on its own chunk and returns early -- but only when it actually produced entries, which is what the predicate checks.
No choices: the usage-only chunk from stream_options.include_usage. Emits usage if present and returns either way.

default._note: reasoning_content comes from OpenAI-compatible providers (DeepSeek, xAI via Chat Completions), never from OpenAI itself.
